company.legal_form: SELAS (Societe d'Exercice Liberal par Actions Simplifiee)
company.description: Fidal is the largest France-based business law firm by revenues, and one of the 100 largest law firms in the world. Founded in 1922, Fidal advises businesses on all aspects of business law including tax, corporate, labor, M&A, real estate, IP, and digital/tech law.

financials.revenue_note: Largest France-based law firm by revenue

footprint.international_presence: Partners in 150+ countries via WTS Global and Unyer networks

networks_and_alliances.name: WTS Global
networks_and_alliances.description: Independent law/consulting firms with strong local market presence

networks_and_alliances.name: Unyer
networks_and_alliances.description: Co-founded with German firm Luther in 2021. 2,550+ lawyers/consultants in 14+ countries across Europe and Asia. EUR 650M combined revenue.

subsidiaries.name: Fidal Innovation
subsidiaries.activity: Industrial property / Patent engineering / CIR (Research Tax Credit) consulting

subsidiaries.name: Fidal Formations
subsidiaries.activity: Professional legal training delivered by Fidal lawyers

company.ownership: 100% partner-owned. Over one-third of lawyers hold equity. 40% of shareholders are women. No external parent company.
company.kpmg_relationship: ENDED July 2019. Non-exclusive cooperation agreement terminated. KPMG Avocats is now a direct competitor. Fidal is fully independent.
rankings: Largest France-based law firm by revenues
